notes.title: BWUDALING UPDATE (v1.1)
notes.content:
FUN STUFF ADDED! YOU THOUGHT BWUDALING COULDN'T GET ANY BETTER...AND YET IT DID

New Stuff!
Bwuda's Rainbow String
The Rainbow String has appeared...tired of being wielded by Bwuda to terrify Hoher Piest, it has come after da Bwudahood to destroy it once and for all...

Speedrun Mode
Want to flex your incredible win speed to your friends? Now runs are timed, and you can unlock new shirts for defeating bosses faster than Bwuda!

Victory Dances
More dances! Select a dance while customizing your Bwudaling, and show your joy at clearing a level!

(Slightly) Improved Single Player!
If all Bwuda's Wuvas should tragically fall in battle, they will have the option to respawn at the last safe zone they reached, forfeiting the XP for that lane, and no longer will single players have to restart a map when they die!

Balance Changes & Bug Fixes

 Dogie 'Fetch' ability now autotargets and pulls nearby Bwudalings rather than firing a single projectile
 Bwuda 'Resurrection' ability now correctly targets nearby Bwudalings to revive them
 Bwudalings helping each other get to a safe zone will receive a small XP boost
 Lowered saw count on Big Wed - 3
 Wuva 'Worship' ability correctly plays animations on clients
 Custom keybindings display marginally better
 Can no longer teleport out of the start zone before wall disappears
 Boss achievements will correctly unlock for everyone, not just the host
 The upgrade tab can be toggled with a hotkey (default is [tab])
